Czech Intrastat (InstatOnline CSV) — Community

The monthly Czech Intrastat declaration generated on the OCA Intrastat engine as the CSV file the customs administration's InstatOnline portal imports.

Version19.0.1.0.0
EditionCommunity and Enterprise
LicenceAGPL-3
Requiresintrastat_product, l10n_cssk_intrastat_base, l10n_cz

What it is for

A Czech business whose trade in goods with other EU countries reaches the reporting threshold files a monthly výkaz pro Intrastat (Intrastat declaration) with the customs administration (Celní správa): one for goods dispatched to other EU countries and one for goods received from them.

On Community, the OCA module intrastat_product collects the figures from invoices, but it has no Czech output. This module adds it: for a Czech company, the declaration file is the CSV that the customs administration's InstatOnline portal imports, instead of an XML file. The column layout, the fixed values and the number format are those of Odoo Enterprise's own Czech Intrastat module, so a company moving between editions files the same data.

It is deliberately not named l10n_cz_intrastat: that is Odoo Enterprise's module, which an Enterprise database uses instead. Install one or the other.

Legal background

  • EU framework. Intrastat is part of the European business statistics of Regulation (EU) 2019/2152. Article 13(1) lists what the exporting country passes on about each intra-EU export, including the partner's VAT identification number in the country of import and the country of origin.
  • Who reports, and when — celní zákon (Customs Act) No. 242/2016 Sb., § 57 to § 60:
  • a reporting unit (zpravodajská jednotka) reports once it reaches the threshold (§ 57 odst. 1), for calendar months (§ 58 odst. 2), until the end of that year and for the whole following year (§ 58 odst. 4);
  • the declaration is due no later than the 12th working day of the following month, filed through the electronic portal run by the General Directorate of Customs (§ 58 odst. 5);
  • corrected or missing data must be reported within 30 days of learning of the error (§ 60 písm. a).
  • Thresholds — nařízení vlády (government decree) No. 333/2021 Sb., příloha č. 3: the reporting threshold is 15 000 000 Kč of goods dispatched, and separately 15 000 000 Kč of goods received, counted from the beginning of the calendar year; each flow is declared separately from the month in which it reached the threshold.

The module does not check thresholds. Set the flows in the settings according to your obligation.

Setting it up

  1. Accounting → Configuration → Settings, block Intrastat: set Arrivals (Přijetí) and Dispatches (Odeslání) to Standard or Extended for each flow you report, Exempt for the other; optionally a Default Transport Mode.
  2. Commodity codes must exist in Odoo: enter them, or load the Combined Nomenclature with the OCA module intrastat_product_hscodes_import, which this module does not install by itself.
  3. On each stockable product: Kód zboží (KN) (H.S. Code), Země původu (Country of Origin) and the weight in kg.
  4. Your company needs its DIČ (VAT number); without it the file is not generated.

Monthly declaration

Accounting → Reporting → Intrastat → Výkaz produktů Intrastat (Intrastat Product Declaration), then New. On Community without full accounting the menu root reads Fakturace.

  1. Choose the year, month and type — Přijetí (Arrivals) or Odeslání (Dispatches).
  2. Generovat řádky z faktur (Generate Lines from Invoices), check the Transakce tab, correct invoices or products and regenerate as needed.
  3. Potvrdit (Confirm) groups the transactions into declaration lines.
  4. Generovat XML soubor (Generate XML File — the button keeps the engine's name) creates the CSV, attaches it as YYYY-MM_<type>_<revision>.csv and marks the declaration Dokončeno.
  5. Upload the file in InstatOnline on the customs administration's portal, which checks it on upload (there is no schema to validate against in advance).

Each line of the file holds: month; year; your DIČ; flow (A arrivals, D dispatches); partner's VAT number; partner country; region (empty); country of origin; nature of transaction (two digits, e.g. 11); mode of transport; delivery terms (Incoterm); code of movement ST; commodity code (spaces removed); statistical sign and description (both empty); net mass; quantity in supplementary units; invoiced value in the company currency. Mass and supplementary units up to 1 are written with three decimals, larger ones as whole numbers.

Statutory footprint

With l10n_cssk_core installed, l10n_cssk_intrastat_footprint installs itself and lists, in the Statutory footprint of a posted document, every Intrastat declaration that took one of its lines — period, flow and state — with a link. A month whose declaration has not been generated yet shows nothing. The full description is in the Slovak Intrastat guide.

The shared renderer

The CSV itself is produced by l10n_cssk_intrastat_base, which also renders the Slovak INSTAT XML. It has no screens and installs automatically with this module.

Limitations

  • Decimals are cut off, not rounded: net mass and supplementary units above 1, and the invoiced value, are written as their whole-number part (13.9 kg becomes 13; 800.75 Kč becomes 800). This matches Odoo Enterprise's Czech module; check it against InstatOnline's rules if your values carry decimals.
  • Region, statistical sign and description of goods are always left empty; the code of movement is always ST.
  • Corrections: a copied declaration gets the next revision and a new file name, but the file itself has no correction marker. Make corrections in InstatOnline within the 30-day limit.
  • The simplified declaration (zjednodušené hlášení) is not produced.
  • Thresholds are not checked: the module files what you ask it to file.
  • Filing happens in InstatOnline, outside Odoo.
